title: Who pays for electricity non-payment in South Africa?
text:
This site hosts three linked research projects on electricity non-payment, tariffs and affordability in South Africa.

Project A: who pays, who can’t, and what the tariff would be if able-to-pay non-payers paid.
Project B: whether Eskom’s tariff requests are fair and market-related.
Project C: tariff-driven defaults and a tipping-point model.

See the dashboard for Project A. Code and data notes are in the GitHub repository.
